creator.benefit: Sole authorized human. Benefits from goal achievement three ways: (1) AUTONO token position appreciates as the flywheel turns (launchpad protocol fees in DIEM flow to the agent FeeLocker, driving AUTONO/DIEM volume); (2) zero inference subsidy once self-funding ratio >= 1.0 — the direct-fallback Claude OAuth token stops being drawn on; (3) weekly goal-review report delivered via Telegram is the accountability artifact.
